title_en: DC Finally Unites Its Hit Absolute Universe Heroes in Absolute Justice, a Massive New Crossover Event Shaking Up the Entire Line
summary_en: DC has revealed exciting new details about Absolute Justice, the epic 2027 crossover that pits Batman and his allies against the Justice League.
body_en:
DC's Absolute Universe line is a huge hit, but outside of a brief Absolute Batman/Absolute Wonder Woman crossover, we've yet to see the heroes of this bleak world join forces. That's finally set to change in early 2027 as DC kicks off Absolute Justice.
Absolute Justice is a five-issue limited series that brings together Batman, Superman, Wonder Woman, Flash, Green Lantern, and Martian Manhunter. These six heroes will be forced to unite against the Justice League , which in this world consists of billionaires and oligarchs like Ra's al Ghul, Veronica Cale, Hector Hammond, Dr. Elenore Thawne, Lex Luthor, and Jack Grimm (aka The Joker). DC promises that the series will be completely standalone, "with no tie-in issues, no crossovers, and no mercy shown!"
Absolute Justice is written by Absolute Superman's Jason Aaron, with art by Juan Ferreyra (who drew the latter half of Aaron's TMNT run). The first issue features a host of covers, including a main cover by Ferreyra and variants by Stanley “Artgerm” Lau, Gabriele Dell’Otto, Rafael Albuquerque, and Kyuyong Eom. Issue #1 will also be available as a $9.99 blind bag variant, with exclusive covers by Jim Lee, Kaare Andrews, Mark Brooks, Dan Mora, and Álvaro Martínez Bueno.

Absolute Evil #1 will be released on April 7, 2027. You can preorder a copy at your local comic shop .
For more on the Absolute Universe, check out IGN's review of Absolute Batman #24 and see how Absolute Batman #25 drops the series' biggest twist yet .
